summary: Comprehensive backend testing of SafeCount complete (8/8 pytest tests passed). Verified auth (JWT, _id/password_hash excluded), teams enrichment, members count (22+), 3 assembly points, and full alert flow (start drill → active → respond safe → mark-safe → remind → end → report → history). Frontend smoke tested: login with Firewatch demo chip works, navigates to /role-select, role card tap goes to /firewatch which correctly shows Warehouse Shift A card (20 people, Main Gate, START EMERGENCY + START DRILL).

minor.issue: Root route inside /api returns 404 because /api/ APIRouter has a root mounted but ingress likely strips trailing slash — backend log shows '/api/ 404'. Not user-facing; harmless.

ui_bugs.component: firewatch.tsx — START DRILL / START EMERGENCY buttons
ui_bugs.issue: Buttons render with text split into two lines ("START\nDRILL") and lack testID, so text-based locators collide with the role-card description text on /role-select. Add testID="start-drill-btn" and testID="start-emergency-btn" for reliable testing.

Role cards (Firewatch/Admin/Member) and login demo chips have no testID. The cards are clickable but rely on visible text 'Firewatch' which clashes with screen titles. Add testIDs like role-card-firewatch / demo-chip-firewatch.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Update any <Image style={{resizeMode:...}}/> to <Image resizeMode={...}/>.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents into style.

action_items: Add testID props to all interactive elements in: app/index.tsx (email-input, password-input, demo-chip-admin/firewatch/member, login-button), app/role-select.tsx (role-card-firewatch/admin/member), app/firewatch.tsx (start-emergency-btn, start-drill-btn), app/firewatch-alert.tsx (type chips, message input, confirm-start-btn), app/firewatch-live.tsx (end-alert-btn, remind-btn, mark-safe-btn per member), app/member-alert.tsx (i-am-safe-btn, need-help-btn, not-here-btn, assembly-point-N, confirm-btn).
Replace deprecated Image style.resizeMode with prop, and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.
Optional: split START DRILL / START EMERGENCY labels onto a single line or wrap entire pressable as one accessible button so e2e text-locator works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: GET /api/ root works only without trailing slash. Either add @api.get('') or accept; minor.
server.py: get_responses counts 'manually_marked_safe' under safe correctly, but summary key 'not_at_location' is initialized to 0 only after 'not_responded' — works fine since enumerated; no bug.
server.py: alerts endpoints lack role authorization — any authenticated user can call /alerts/{id}/end, /mark-safe, /remind. For MVP fine, but worth a TODO.
server.py: send_sms_stub is correctly a no-op when Twilio env vars are empty — MOCKED as expected per problem statement.
Frontend: many interactive components missing testID — adding them is the single biggest improvement for automated QA.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (smoke verified through firewatch dashboard; deeper drill→live→report UI walk blocked by missing testIDs)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing seeded org Vilnius Logistics Center with Jonas + 20 Lithuanian members. Tests create transient alerts which remain in history (acceptable for demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend stable and fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_safecount_api.py. For UI re-test, request E1 to add testIDs listed in action_items, then run Playwright walkthrough: login(jonas) → role-select → firewatch → start drill (testID start-drill-btn) → confirm → firewatch-live → verify summary card → end-alert → report. Separately login(ruta) in a second context, expect auto-navigation to /member-alert via 5s polling, tap i-am-safe-btn → choose assembly point → confirm. Note SMS is intentionally MOCKED (log-only stub).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The frontend test limitation is a test-tooling issue (missing testIDs causing text-locator ambiguity), not an app defect.
